g.text: Ingress: Gateway API + cert-manager vs Cloudflare Tunnel (cloudflared overlay)

text.tspan: • DNS A record points to the LB
• TLS terminates at the Cloudflare edge; in-cluster traffic is plain HTTP
• Routing and DNS managed in the Cloudflare dashboard
• Traefik / cert-manager / Gateway / Issuer disabled (templates remain for switch-back)
• External vendor on the public data path — opt-in deviation from ADR-0006
• Stackable with values-prod-ha.yaml; MinIO via a Cloudflare public hostname
api / realtime / web / authentik / hydra / minio
